faqs.question: What services does NM OnePoint provide?
faqs.answer: NM OnePoint covers business and tax support, IT solutions, BIM services including Scan to BIM and Revit, and GIS solutions including QGIS and ArcGIS work.

faqs.question: Can I request multiple services together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Business and technical needs can be discussed together, so related requirements stay coordinated through one point of contact.

faqs.question: Do you provide BIM and GIS services?
faqs.answer: Yes. BIM support includes model-based building workflows, Scan to BIM, and Revit. GIS support includes map-based data work with QGIS and ArcGIS.

faqs.question: Can businesses request customized support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scope, deliverables, and timelines are agreed before work begins, so each engagement reflects the specific requirement.

faqs.question: How can I contact NM OnePoint?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact page to share the details of your business or technical requirement, and NM OnePoint will take it from there.
